options.blockHint: Password managers, banking and Windows Security are here by default

modes.cloudHint: Use cloud AI when it gives a better answer.
modes.localHint: Local models first. Cloud AI only when you allow it.
modes.strict-privateHint: Nothing leaves this PC. Personal data is never sent anywhere.
modes.customHint: Choose each kind of cloud processing yourself.

privacy.wakeHint: Audio is only used after you speak to KIVO
privacy.screenshotsHint: Held in memory only, never saved; sent to an AI only when you allow cloud vision
privacy.privateHint: Files here are never read, searched or sent
privacy.neverBody: KIVO will forget each conversation when it ends, and chats won’t be kept.

custom.cloud-brainsHint: Brains that run online, like Claude, GPT or Gemini
custom.personal-to-cloud: Personal details may go to cloud AI
custom.personal-to-cloudHint: Names, email addresses and phone numbers. Sensitive data never does
custom.cloud-speechHint: Speech engines that hear or speak online
custom.cloud-vision: Cloud AI may see the screen
custom.cloud-visionHint: Screenshots, only when you ask about the screen

privacy.localFoldersHint: KIVO can use files here, but only a brain on this PC sees them
privacy.labelsHint: Anything mentioning these stays with a brain on this PC
privacy.labelPlaceholder: A name or word, like Project Falcon
privacy.catalogsHint: Once a day, KIVO looks for newer lists of agents, connectors, plugins and models from its own site, and uses them only if they’re signed. Nothing about you is sent. Never in Strictly private.

bypass.title: Bypass permissions
bypass.detail: For tasks you’re watching. KIVO acts without asking, High risk included, until it turns off.
bypass.dialogDetail: KIVO will act without asking, including deleting, sending and paying.
bypass.warn: Hard limits still apply: emergency stop, capabilities you turned off, blocked apps, password fields, and addresses from untrusted content. Every action is recorded.

cu.frameHint: A border around the screen while KIVO is in control.
cu.cursorHint: A second pointer where KIVO acts; yours stays yours.
cu.highlight: Highlight what it's about to use
cu.islandHint: Step, cost so far, Pause and Stop.
cu.approveHint: Watch mode shows each step and waits for Allow.
cu.pauseOnMouse: Pause when I use the mouse
cu.pauseOnMouseHint: KIVO waits until you've let go for a moment.
cu.maxCostHint: Estimated from the brain's prices; KIVO stops and asks at the limit.

rt.providerHint: Uses a connected OpenAI or Gemini key. The fast path and permissions stay on this PC.
rt.silenceHint: A live conversation closes when nobody has spoken for this long, or when you say “that's all”.

tasks.subtitle: Long-running work and watchers. You can stop any of them.
tasks.noneRunningDetail: Say “tell me when the build finishes” or “remind me in 20 minutes to stretch”.

routines.subtitle: Your own commands. They run instantly, and without AI unless a step asks for it.
routines.newDetail: Start from a template, or from scratch.
routines.noneDetail: Create one, or start from a template.
routines.note: Say a routine’s phrase or press its keys to run it. Anything it wasn’t allowed when you saved it will ask.
routines.name: Name
routines.phrasePlaceholder: A phrase, like “work mode” or “focus for '{'minutes'}'”
routines.allowed: Allowed for this routine: {list}. Anything else will ask.
routines.reviewDetail: The routine may do these without asking, with exactly these settings. Anything else asks.
routines.capabilityOff: That capability is off, so this step will be refused until you turn it on.
routines.aiCosts: Steps that ask AI count toward your usage limits.
routines.withPrevious: Run together with the step before

when.title: Also starts
when.unattended: These start the routine with no one asking, so steps that could do harm ask on screen first.

kinds.usbDevice: When a USB device is plugged in
kinds.network: When the PC joins a network

when.cronHelp: Minute, hour, day, month, weekday — like 30 7 * * mon-fri, or @daily.
when.usbAny: When a USB device is plugged in
when.idle: After {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} away
when.return: When I’m back after {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}

routines.draftReady: A routine is ready for you to check. Save it when it looks right.
routines.imported: “{name}” is ready to check. Saving shows what it may do.
routines.skillMade: “{name}” is now a skill too, for brains and agents to use.

agents.startByVoice: Or just say “Hey Kivo, open Claude in K.I.V.O with auto mode”.
agents.noneToStart: No agent that runs in a terminal is installed yet. Install one below.
agents.subtitle: Other AIs KIVO can run and talk to for you: coding agents, terminals and desktop AI apps.
agents.draftHint: Say “Hey Kivo, tell Claude to also add tests”: KIVO drafts the prompt in the Island and sends it when you say “send”.
agents.noneInstalledDetail: Install Claude Code, Codex or Gemini CLI, then refresh on the Brains page.
agents.desktopDetail: KIVO can type prompts and read replies
agents.bypassRisk: Starting an agent in bypass mode
agents.bypassRiskDetail: Always asks first, because the agent can then change anything
agents.reviewPrompts: Prompts are shown before they’re sent
agents.reviewPromptsDetail: A draft in the Island first: Send, Edit or Cancel
agents.startDetail: In a terminal you can watch. Or say “Hey Kivo, open Claude in K.I.V.O with auto mode”.
agents.noWorkspaces: KIVO doesn’t know any project folders yet. Work in one (VS Code, a terminal) and KIVO offers to remember it.
agents.bypassNote: Bypass lets the agent change anything without asking, so KIVO confirms first.
agents.shareDetail: Through KIVO’s MCP server. Every change it asks for needs your OK.
agents.shareSensitiveDetail: Personal notes and past conversations; off, agents only see the rest
agents.notInstalledHint: KIVO can install it for you, after showing exactly what it will run

workspaces.aboutMePlaceholder: What every brain and agent should know about you: your name, how you like answers, your tools.
workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.noneDetail: When you work in a project folder, KIVO asks whether to remember it.
workspaces.instructionsPlaceholder: Notes for work in {name}: conventions, commands, what to avoid.
workspaces.note: Instructions are also kept as Markdown files in KIVO’s data folder; edits there come back here. A project’s own CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md or GEMINI.md is read, never changed unless you export.

extensions.subtitle: Apps, tools, add-ons and skills that KIVO can use.
extensions.noneReady: Nothing found on this PC yet.
extensions.connectorsNote: Connect signs in in your browser. KIVO never asks for your passwords or API keys, and each connector’s tools wait for your review before KIVO uses them.
extensions.customDetail: Paste a remote MCP server’s address.
extensions.customNote: If the server needs a sign-in, your browser opens. KIVO registers itself, so there’s no key to paste.
extensions.addServerDetail: A remote server by its address, or a program on this PC.
extensions.nothingToImport: No other app has MCP servers KIVO hasn’t imported.
extensions.importNote: Importing copies the setup into KIVO. The other app isn’t changed, keys go to Credential Manager, and every tool is shown before it’s turned on.
extensions.noServersDetail: Import them from another app, or add one.
extensions.riskNote: Medium and High tools follow your permission mode. High always asks unless Bypass is on.
extensions.reviewDetail: These are the server’s own words, and they may try to instruct an AI. Turn on only the tools you want KIVO to use.
extensions.trustNote: Only add servers you trust. KIVO shows every tool the server offers before turning it on.
extensions.pluginsLaterDetail: Plugins will add commands, voices and Island styles, each in a sandbox with only the permissions you grant. Until then, MCP servers and skills extend KIVO.
extensions.noSkills: No skills yet. Put one in KIVO’s skills folder, or add a folder or zip.
extensions.skillsNote: Skills use the open SKILL.md format, so skills made for Claude, Codex or Gemini work here too. Only a skill’s name and description are sent with a request; the rest loads when a task needs it.
extensions.reviewSkillDetail: What the skill tells the AI to do, and its files. Scripts run through the shell, and ask like any command.
extensions.toolsUsed: {count, plural, one {# tool} other {# tools}} · last used {when}

memory.subtitle: What KIVO knows about you and your work: Markdown notes on this PC, organized by folders and tags.
memory.workspaceNotesDetail: Notes for projects KIVO works on with you, kept short and tidy
memory.rememberDetail: A short fact, preference or decision. It becomes a note you can edit later.
memory.emptyDetail: Say “Kivo, remember …”, or add something here. Workspace notes appear as KIVO works on your projects.
memory.noAboutDetail: Tell KIVO about yourself in Brains → Context, or add about-me.md to the memory folder.
memory.supersededNote: A newer note replaced this on {date}. It stays as history.
memory.linked: {count, plural, one {# linked note} other {# linked notes}}
memory.shareCloud: Allow cloud AI to see this note
memory.shareCloudDetail: Only when “Never send sensitive notes to cloud AI” is off
memory.editDetail: This is the Markdown file itself. Front-matter at the top holds its type, tags and sensitivity.
memory.condenseDetail: Into the workspace overview and decisions
memory.noCloud: Never send sensitive notes to cloud AI
memory.noCloudDetail: Personal notes can still help cloud brains; sensitive ones stay on this PC
memory.agentsDetail: Claude Code, Codex and others, through KIVO’s memory MCP. Choose agents in Agents.
memory.tidyNowDetail: Runs by itself once a day
memory.exportDetail: Every note as JSON, to your Downloads folder
memory.forgetConfirm: {count, plural, one {# note} other {# notes}} and every suggestion will be deleted from this PC. This can’t be undone.
memory.note: Your memory is a folder of Markdown files: {folder}. Edit them anywhere; KIVO reads the changes. Notes never hold passwords or keys.
memory.askNewDetail: KIVO asks the first time it works in a workspace; say no and it keeps none there
memory.graphLabel: {notes, plural, one {Memory graph of # note} other {Memory graph of # notes}}
memory.graphNote: {title}, {count, plural, =0 {no links} one {# link} other {# links}}
memory.graphHidden: {count, plural, one {# less-used note isn’t shown} other {# less-used notes aren’t shown}}

usage.subtitle: Estimated cost of cloud AI and speech. Work done on this PC is free.
usage.chartLabel: Estimated spend per day, AI and speech
usage.unpriced: {count, plural, one {# request used a model with no known price and isn’t counted.} other {# requests used models with no known price and aren’t counted.}}
usage.monthlyBudgetDetail: All cloud AI and speech. Off: KIVO only tracks spending.
usage.capsDetail: The most one task may spend. KIVO asks before going over.
usage.capsEmpty: Leave a field empty for no limit.
usage.showCost: Show the cost in the card
usage.showCostDetail: A live “≈ $0.12” next to the brain while it answers
usage.note: All costs are estimates from public price lists, refreshed weekly. Your provider’s bill is what counts.

install.title: Install {name}
install.explain: This is everything KIVO will do. Nothing runs until you press Install.
install.consent: Installing downloads software from its publisher (winget or npm) and accepts its licence terms.

updates.title: Updates
updates.ready: KIVO {version} is ready. Takes about 20 seconds; anything running is saved first.
updates.notThisBuild: This copy can’t update itself (a development build).
updates.channelHint: Beta and Experimental get features sooner
updates.dailyHint: Never in Strictly private. Updates are signed and checked before they install.

callKivo.title: How you call KIVO
callKivo.wakeHint: Hands-free: KIVO wakes when it hears its name.
callKivo.wakeTip: Only for its name, on this PC. Nothing is recorded or sent until you say “Hey Kivo”. Turning it on downloads a small listener (about 20 MB).
callKivo.pttHint: Hold the keys while you speak. Works well in noisy rooms.
callKivo.oneStays: At least one stays on, so you can always reach KIVO.
callKivo.pttChange: Click the keys to change them.
